title: Plasma Orb in Desert
description: A large transparent plasma globe with a glowing red core and vibrant pink, purple and yellow electrical tendrils dominates the center. It stands on a black pedestal in a surreal desert landscape with red ground, sparse cacti, and a 'do not enter' sign to the right, under a swirling cosmic sky filled with colorful nebulae and dark floating orbs.
prompt: Surreal desert landscape at night featuring a giant transparent plasma globe with a bright red central orb emitting vibrant pink, purple and yellow electrical tendrils. The globe rests on a black pedestal. Red sandy ground with sparse cacti and a circular red 'do not enter' road sign on the right. Dramatic swirling cosmic sky in yellow, pink and red with large dark floating orbs and stars, painterly style with visible brushstrokes.
